# Release Engine v13.3.1: the release PR (preparation leaf of #20022)

## Context

The cut record #20022 holds the gate ticks and the cut mechanics for 13.3.1. `publish.mjs prepare` opens the release PR against a preparation leaf it resolves, so the record stays open until `finish`, npm and the Portal read back (the #19652 shape). This is that leaf. It is filed at cut time, after the candidate is qualified on #20022 (the qualification header of 2026-10-23 22:2xZ names `dev` 36a74c743c, AC-1 to AC-4 ticked there) and the cut-prep PR #20024 (Resolves #20023: the note, the bump to 13.3.1, the `v13.3.0.md` drop) has merged last before `prepare`.

## The Problem

Nothing to fix: the leaf exists so the release PR has exactly one standalone `Resolves`, and so the record can keep its post-merge ticks.

## The Architectural Reality

`buildScripts/release/publish.mjs`: `prepare` preflights (on `dev` at `origin/dev`, clean, `package.json` bumped to 13.3.1, `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.1.md` present, no tag), checks the body against this leaf, drops older notes, builds, commits once on the release branch and opens the PR; the operator merges it (the one human step); `finish` squashes to `main` with the atomic line, tags, and publishes through `npm-publish.yml` (OIDC).

## The Fix

Run `prepare --rehearse`, then `prepare`, with this leaf as `--ticket` and the body file as `--body-file`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The release PR's head carries exactly `prepare`'s release commit on top of `dev` at the qualified candidate named in #20022's qualification header, plus #20024's merge.
- [ ] AC-2: `package.json` and the lock's root read 13.3.1, `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.1.md` is the only note under `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/`, and the note's status banner is gone.
- [ ] AC-3: The release PR passed `dev`'s required checks and CodeQL with no ruleset bypass (#20022 AC-5).
- [ ] AC-4 (post-merge): `finish` succeeded; the GitHub release `Neo.mjs v13.3.1 Release Notes` ends with the atomic-commit line; npm `neo.mjs@latest` is 13.3.1 (#20022 AC-6, AC-7).

## Out of Scope

The gate (D#19994, ticked on #20022), the note's prose (#20023), the Brain post-release sync, Pages and create-app (their runbooks, recorded on #20022 AC-8).
